rv.q: This revival by the Kiln’s artistic director Amit Sharma is perhaps a step towards cementing it as a classic for which productions can – and should – come about quite regularly.
Natasha Gordon’s Nine Night earns the title of modern classic, and Amit Sharma’s production should help to cement that legacy.
Nine Night is funny, moving, gloriously unfiltered and full of heart.

cn.t: Critics embrace this Kiln Theatre revival of Natasha Gordon's *Nine Night*, praising its blend of grief, humor, and Jamaican culture. Llewella Gideon earns particular acclaim as the scene-stealing Auntie Maggie.
